{"metadata":{"description":"Learning assistant extension for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): brings DeepTutor tutoring to your agent — deep explanations, self-test questions, learning paths, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving. | 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的学习辅助扩展:为 agent 接入 DeepTutor 辅导能力 —— 深度讲解、自测题","id":"gh:1333263088","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-deeptutor","slug":"TecFancy/dsh-deeptutor","topics":["agent","deepseek-harness","deeptutor","dsh","dsh-plugin","llm","rag","tutoring"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Learning assistant extension for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): brings DeepTutor tutoring to your agent — d"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"eep explanations, self-test questions, learning paths, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and not"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"e archiving. | 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的学习辅助扩展:为 agent 接入 DeepTutor 辅导能力 —— 深度讲解、自测题"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-deeptutor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A **learning-assistant extension for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) and Claude Code**.
It connects your agen"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"t to a HKUDS/DeepTutor
tutoring service, so a session can explain topics in depth, quiz you, plan
le"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"arning paths, search your personal knowledge bases, and keep a study
notebook, all without leaving t"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"he agent. In dsh it loads as a bundle; in
Claude Code (or any MCP client) the same tools are served "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"by a bundled MCP
server, installed as a Claude Code plugin."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Ask the agent *"teach me async/await"* and it can run a deep-solve, render the
answer as a self-cont"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ained HTML study page you can open in a browser, and
archive a summary into your notebook."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it adds"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Four agent-facing tools that the model uses whenever you ask for learning help:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| `deeptutor_run` | Runs one learning capability, e.g. `deep_solve` (in-depth explanation), `deep_qu"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"estion` (self-test questions), `deep_research`, `chat`, `mastery_path` (learning-path planning), `vi"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"sualize`. Can mount your knowledge bases (`kbs`) and tools (`rag`, `web_search`, `reason`, `code_exe"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"cution`, …); returns a `session_id` so later turns continue the same context, and can render the ans"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"wer to an HTML study page. |
| `deeptutor_kb` | Lists, searches, and inspects your personal knowledg"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"e bases (RAG) |
| `deeptutor_note` | Archives Markdown study notes (plans, summaries, wrong answers)"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" into a server notebook |
| `deeptutor_cli` | Runs any other DeepTutor CLI command, behind safety ti"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"r notebook |
| `deeptutor_cli` | Runs any other DeepTutor CLI command, behind safety tiers (below) |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Following DeepTutor upgrades without plugin releases"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The plugin does not mirror DeepTutor's command surface, so a DeepTutor upgrade
that adds commands, c"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"apabilities or tools needs no plugin change:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Capabilities are discovered at runtime.** `deeptutor_run` takes any
capability name. The plugin "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"reads `deeptutor module list` (JSON, cached for
five minutes) to learn which capabilities the deploy"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ment's ready modules
provide; a capability whose module is not ready fails fast with the reason and
"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"the list of available ones, and names no module lists are passed straight to
the CLI (they may come "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"from a DeepTutor plugin).
- **Every other command goes through `deeptutor_cli`.** The agent discover"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"s
commands from the CLI itself (`args: ["--help"]`, then `["kb", "--help"]`, …)
instead of a list ba"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ked into the plugin. Safety tiers keep the passthrough
honest about commands it has never seen:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Tier | Commands | Behaviour |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| read | `--help`, verbs `list` / `show` / `info` / `search` / `state` / `status` / `list-*`, `docto"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"r`, `run` | runs directly |
| confirm | everything else, including verbs the plugin does not know ye"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"t | runs only with `confirm: true`, which the agent may set only after you explicitly asked for that"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" change |
| blocked | `delete`, `remove*`, `clear`, `uninstall`, `rollback`, `login`, …; interactive"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" or long-running `chat` / `start` / `stop` / `serve` / `init` | refused; run them in a terminal your"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ng-running `chat` / `start` / `stop` / `serve` / `init` | refused; run them in a terminal yourself |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Drift check.** Only the few CLI shapes the dedicated tools are built on
(`run --format json` eve"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"nts, `kb search`, `notebook add-md`, `module list`)
can break the plugin. `npm run check:cli` checks"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" them against the deployment
your env vars point at; run it after upgrading DeepTutor."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Example session"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"A typical flow when you ask your agent for learning help:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. **Ask** — *"Explain C# generics covariance using my dotnet knowledge base, and generate a study p"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"age."*
2. The agent grounds the answer in your own material: `deeptutor_kb` (`action=search`, `kb=do"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"tnet`).
3. It runs a deep-solve: `deeptutor_run` (`capability=deep_solve`, `kbs=[dotnet]`, `html=dat"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"a/study/csharp-covariance.html`) — the answer comes back and a self-contained HTML page (plus the `."},{"id":"p18s5","text":"md` source) is written to disk.
4. It files a summary: `deeptutor_note` (`notebook=dotnet-learning`,"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"written to disk.
4. It files a summary: `deeptutor_note` (`notebook=dotnet-learning`, `type=solve`)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Nothing here is a fixed script — the agent picks the tools and parameters based
on what you ask for."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- An agent host: Claude Code (or another MCP client) with Node ≥ 20, or a
working DeepSeek Harness ("},{"id":"p22s2","text":"dsh) install, 0.1.0-rc.6 or newer. The manifest
declares a version floor rather than a ceiling, so a"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" new dsh release is never
refused at install time; a scheduled probe boots the plugin against the
cu"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"rrent npm `latest` and `next` hosts instead and opens an issue when
activation breaks. Bundle auto-r"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"egistration via `dsh plugin add` was verified
on dsh CLI 0.1.0-rc.6, 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3.
- A "},{"id":"p22s6","text":"DeepTutor deployment, either:
- **Local** — the `deeptutor` CLI installed on this machine (on `PATH`"},{"id":"p22s7","text":", or
pointed to by `DEEPTUTOR_LOCAL_BIN`);
- **Remote** — DeepTutor installed on a server you can re"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"ach with
passwordless SSH; the plugin runs the server's CLI over SSH."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Tested against DeepTutor 1.7.1. Since 1.7 the `kb` and `notebook` commands
and most capabilities com"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"e from optional modules; check that the ones you
use are installed and enabled with `deeptutor modul"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ptional modules; check that the ones you
use are installed and enabled with `deeptutor module list`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Every tool call drives the DeepTutor CLI: the local `deeptutor` binary, or the
remote binary over SS"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"H when `DEEPTUTOR_SSH_HOST` is set. `deeptutor serve` does
not need to be reachable from this machin"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"when `DEEPTUTOR_SSH_HOST` is set. `deeptutor serve` does
not need to be reachable from this machine."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Earlier versions tried the HTTP/WebSocket API first (`/api/v1/...` through an
SSH tunnel) and only t"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"hen fell back to the CLI. DeepTutor 1.7 serves those
routes under different paths and behind a login"},{"id":"p26s3","text":", so the probe always failed
and each call waited about 30 seconds before reaching the CLI. That pat"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"h was
removed; `DEEPTUTOR_API_BASE` is no longer read."}],"truncated":true}
